title: ONSure Requalification Trigger Evaluation v1
description: FR-META-059 ONSure Release Qualification / 34_AI_RUNTIME_MULTI_AGENT_AND_ONSURE_META_ASSURANCE_EXTENSION.md SS14 Requalification Trigger: 9 named conditions (validator implementation change, Oracle/rubric change, Adapter/Plugin change, benchmark/hidden corpus material change, sandbox/TCB/crypto change, major dependency/runtime change, MissedFinding blind-spot confirmation, severity/coverage policy weakening, provider/model change for AI validator) each independently force requalification; 'Impact analysis 결과에 따라 full/partial requalification 범위를 정한다.' SS14 itself does not define the full-vs-partial rule, so this schema commits to an explicit, disclosed one: sandbox/TCB/crypto change, a confirmed MissedFinding blind spot, or a weakened severity/coverage policy are trust-boundary-level changes that force FULL requalification regardless of any other flag; the remaining 6 triggers (each a narrower, localized change) force only PARTIAL requalification when no FULL-tier trigger is also present. Complements onsure-release-qualification.v1.schema.json (Batch 5 slice 4, which qualifies a release as of one point in time) by deciding whether that qualification must be redone at all.
